name: presentations
description: PPTX presentation production skills and a PowerPoint viewer panel, published as an official CodeFusion plugin.

description_i18n.en: Presentation production skills for PPTX, with a visual acceptance reviewer agent. View decks in a side panel: reference slides in chat, and the agent can read, search, point at and capture them.
description_i18n.zh-CN: PPTX presentation crafting skill featuring a visual review agent. Also allows viewing presentations in the sidebar and referencing slides in chat, where the Agent can read, search, locate, highlight, and capture screenshots.
